name: polaris-email
description: Managed email service for the polaris-* family. Cloudflare Workers + Docker bridge.

scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm fmt:check

pnpm.//: webpack >=5.106 breaks docusaurus build (facebook/docusaurus#11923). Pin docusaurus's webpack to the last working release. The scoped override only affects @docusaurus/core's resolution — other webpack consumers (vitest-pool-workers, etc.) are untouched. @types/react is pinned to 19 globally so apps/panel's React 19 ReactNode (which includes bigint) doesn't clash with Docusaurus's React 18 transitive types — Docusaurus tolerates the type-skew at build time.
